headline: Too much or too little sleep may make your body age faster, new Columbia University study suggests.
reason: A new analysis from Columbia University Irving Medical Center, published on August 24, 2026, suggests that both insufficient and excessive sleep are linked to accelerated biological aging across various bodily organs. The study, analyzing 23 biological aging clocks, found that sleeping approximately 6.4 to 7.8 hours per day was associated with the healthiest aging patterns, offering actionable insights for human healthspan and longevity.

headline: XPENG Robotics raises over US$900 million at US$6.3 billion valuation to accelerate physical AI deployment.
reason: On August 25, 2026, XPENG's robotics business announced a private financing round exceeding US$900 million, valuing the company at over US$6.3 billion. This significant investment, the largest single-round private financing in China's embodied AI industry, is set to accelerate the mass production and R&D of XPENG's humanoid robots and Physical AI models, marking a major business development in the rapidly evolving AI and robotics market.

headline: Robot 'Tian Gong Ultra' breaks Usain Bolt's 100m sprint world record at 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing.
reason: At the 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games, updated on August 24, 2026, the 'Tian Gong Ultra' humanoid robot recorded a 100m sprint time of 9.39 seconds, surpassing Usain Bolt's human world record of 9.58 seconds. This achievement signifies a groundbreaking advancement in robotics features, particularly in speed, dexterity, and autonomous physical performance, pushing the boundaries of human-robot capabilities in real-world applications.

headline: Egypt's Foreign Minister and US Advisor coordinate on de-escalation in Sudan, Libya, and Horn of Africa.
reason: On August 24, 2026, Egypt's Minister of Foreign Affairs, Badr Abdelatty, and Massad Boulos, Senior Advisor to the US President for Arab and African Affairs, held discussions to coordinate efforts aimed at de-escalating ongoing conflicts in Sudan, Libya, and the Horn of Africa. This collaboration highlights active diplomatic initiatives towards resolving complex regional crises and fostering geopolitical stability.
